movie.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
movie.overview: Singer Freddie Mercury, guitarist Brian May, drummer Roger Taylor and bass guitarist John Deacon take the music world by storm when they form the rock 'n' roll band Queen in 1970. Hit songs become instant classics. When Mercury's increasingly wild lifestyle starts to spiral out of control, Queen soon faces its greatest challenge yet – finding a way to keep the band together amid the success and excess.

facts: The iconic song "Bohemian Rhapsody" is quite the musical journey, actually! It's structured as a five-part suite, featuring an introduction, a ballad, an opera section, a hard rock segment, and a reflective coda.
Did you know the legendary band Queen, fronted by Freddie Mercury, first burst onto the music scene and formed back in 1970? That's when the original lineup truly took the world by storm!

Here's an interesting fact about the song "Bohemian Rhapsody": it was one of the rare progressive rock songs from the 1970s that successfully reached a massive mainstream audience, making it quite a standout for its genre at the time.
